name: Anastasia Volkov
bio:
Anastasia's fascination with motorsport began during her childhood, fueled by her grandfather's stories of Soviet-era rallies. She excelled in her electrical engineering studies at Bauman Moscow State Technical University, focusing on advanced sensor technology and data acquisition systems. After graduating with honors, she sought to combine her technical skills with her passion for racing. 

Anastasia is meticulous and highly analytical in her approach to electronics engineering. She thrives under pressure and is known for her ability to diagnose and resolve complex electrical issues quickly. Her ambition is to contribute directly to the performance of the team’s vehicle, pushing the boundaries of what's possible with advanced electronics. She joined Proton by Premotion eager to prove herself in the demanding world of Formula racing, aiming to become a leading figure in motorsport electronics engineering.

She sees her role as vital, not just in maintaining the car's systems, but in actively improving its performance through data analysis and innovative solutions. Anastasia is driven by a desire to see her work translate directly into on-track success, constantly pushing herself and those around her to achieve the best possible results.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair often pulled back into a high ponytail during work
physical.description: Anastasia is a slender woman with a sharp, focused gaze and a determined expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with circuit diagrams and technical notes.
Insists on performing a full diagnostic check on any piece of equipment, even if it was just calibrated.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rapidly when deep in thought.
